title: 13 Squid Ionian Irish Whiskey Cream & Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: With Ionian, 13 Squid have truly summoned the Craic -en with an exquisite e-liquid booming with smooth, silky Irish whiskey cream flavour. Deliciously complex yet soothing and comforting, with the lightest touch of icy menthol for a perfect finish, this rich and creamy e-liquid will set your tastebuds sailing with pleasure. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
